svg.title: Broadway
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. Tate-authorized reproduction in TimeSpans2018 brochure, printedp28/PDFp16. Red-orange upper field and white lower painted band retained. Hue is ambiguous between red and orange in the authorized reproduction; both filter families are recorded, while the vector retains the observed orange hue. Photography slightly oblique; narrow right-edge strip is not confidently distinct from perspective and is not invented as a separate panel.
